title: A Couple of Cuckoos
description: 16-year-old super-studier Nagi Umino, second-year student at the Megurogawa Academy high school, was switched at birth. On his way to a dinner to meet his birth parents, he accidentally meets the brash, outspoken, Erika Amano, who is determined to make Nagi her fake boyfriend as she never wants to actually marry. But once Nagi makes it to dinner, he finds his parents have decided to resolve the hospital switch by conveniently having him marry the daughter his birth parents raised…who turns out to be none other than Erika herself!

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Umino Nagi was swapped with another child at birth. He’s going to meet his real parents today, but on his way to school, he meets a girl who is threatening to die to get out of her engagement.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Nagi and Erika are now engaged, but Nagi can’t wrap his head around how loaded Erika is, and Erika seems to have concerns of her own.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Living together with Erika gives Nagi an opportunity to focus on exam prep, except when they run into trouble.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Having scored higher than anyone else in his grade, including Hiro, Nagi decides to finally confess to her.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Hiro and Nagi begin studying together in the mornings, but unexpected circumstances put a wrench in their relationship.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x6
episodes_data.description: Erika joins Nagi’s and Hiro’s morning study sessions to wingman for Nagi, and Hiro wants to come hang out at her place.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x7
episodes_data.description: Nagi invites Hiro to join his group for a school field trip. The group is plunged into chaos with the addition of a couple more members.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x8
episodes_data.description: Sachi notices something going on between Erika and Nagi and decides to try to get to the bottom of it. Both she and Nagi are on the verge of a big decision.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x9
episodes_data.description: Hiro and Nagi go on date at the amusement park. Sachi is not amused.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x10
episodes_data.description: Sachi and Nagi go shopping together for a Mother’s Day gift, but they can’t think of anything their mother would appreciate

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x11
episodes_data.description: Erika and Nagi are stuck in a power outage. Nagi goes to the front door to find an emergency kit, when the unthinkable happens.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x12
episodes_data.description: Nagi tries to redeem himself after embarrassing himself in front of Hiro on their amusement park date.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x13
episodes_data.description: Nagi is beginning to question his own feelings, and he has trouble even focusing on midterms.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x14
episodes_data.description: Erika’s parents want her to come home if she fails her make-up exams. She asks Nagi for help, but it may not be that easy.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x15
episodes_data.description: Erika and Nagi walk around the festival together, and she shocks him with how out-of-touch she is.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x16
episodes_data.description: Sachi is worried about Hiro, so she brings Erika along to follow her and learn about her.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x17
episodes_data.description: Erika, Hiro, Sachi and Nagi make plans to study at Erika’s vacation house, but there ends up being a slight change in the roster.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x18
episodes_data.description: Nagi is hoping to do the test of courage with Hiro, but Erika takes him instead. Nagi can’t figure out what it is that’s bothering her.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x19
episodes_data.description: Erika reveals who it is that she’s been trying to reach through social media.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x20
episodes_data.description: Nagi discusses with Erika what he learned – or tried to learn – from her father.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x21
episodes_data.description: Having topped his grade in the term exams, Nagi confesses to Hiro once again.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x22
episodes_data.description: Erika, Hiro, Sachi, and Nagi spend more time at the beach home retreat, and eventually, clues about Erika's missing older brother are found. This incites Nagi to search for him around the nearby town with Erika by his side.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x23
episodes_data.description: On the day Nagi, Erika, Sachi, and Hiro are to return home, Nagi and Hiro decide to stay behind to collect a shrine stamp from the local temple. However, become of this, their train ride home is canceled due to the stormy weather, thus forcing them to stay at a local inn where things get strangely intimate.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos 1x24
episodes_data.description: The household visits the diner to attend Yohei's birthday party and learn some family secrets surrounding them. The next day after a study session, Erika succumbs to a cold that she caught, and the household, including Hiro, scrambles to help her through it.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Hiro moves in with Nagi, Sachi and Erika. Friction arises, but they're reminded of what happiness might mean.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Hiro is kidnapped and Nagi immediately sets out to save her.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Nagi is suddenly hit with the truth about Ai’s real objective.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Hiro is preparing for a festival that's about to be held at her shrine.

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The world now knows the face of singer Mochizuki Ai, who created the song “Arc Fault.”

episodes_data.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Nagi and Erika are trapped in a hotel room by her mother, who seems to be playing with them.
